subject.title: message tool should auto-select the only enabled account

question: Should omitted message-tool account IDs infer an enabled configured default account or exactly one enabled configured account after channel selection, instead of keeping the current default-account fallback when the default account is disabled?
rationale: The requested behavior changes a documented fallback/default path for outbound message delivery, so maintainer intent is needed before automation or the linked PR should land it across channels.

options.title: Accept the shared resolver policy
options.body: Review and land a shared resolver that preserves explicit/default/bound accounts first, then selects an enabled configured default or exactly one enabled configured account, with clear zero-or-multiple errors.

options.title: Keep explicit account selection
options.body: Document that users must set accountId or defaultAccount when the default account is disabled, and close or narrow the linked implementation PR.

options.title: Require channel-owned behavior
options.body: Ask for a WhatsApp-only or plugin-owned path if maintainers do not want core outbound code to own this fallback policy across channels.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared resolver policy
recommendation.body: Review and land a shared resolver that preserves explicit/default/bound accounts first, then selects an enabled configured default or exactly one enabled configured account, with clear zero-or-multiple errors.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the prior issue review direction and has recent history across the shared outbound/channel/account docs touched by this decision.
